versions.content:
# ARB-AP26 readout (v1 for Corinne)

1. Method: 400 valid of 438 delivered (38 removed per SOW), US finance decision-makers, $50M-$1B revenue, opt-in B2B panels, Oct 19-30; unweighted; no margin of error (opt-in sample).
2. Pain: 64% say manual entry takes too much time; 73% without automation vs 58% with (significant). Not concentrated by size (60 / 65 / 69%, not significant).
3. Close: automation users close in 6.3 days vs 8.6 (significant).
4. ERP change: 45% (180) plan one in 2027. Replacement intent 31% (users) vs 24% (non-users), not significant.
5. Willingness to pay for Plus (valid base): acceptable range $405-$700 per entity per month, optimal $515, indifference $590; users $540 vs non-users $480 optimal.
6. Implications: lead with non-automated teams' pain; ERP change as the trigger; price Plus inside $515-$590.
